description.zh:
网络ACL的描述信息。 

长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the network ACL.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

description.zh:
网络ACL的名称。

长度为1~128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
Enter a name for the network ACL.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-network-acl --network-acl-name acl-1 --description This_is_my_NetworkAcl. --region cn-hangzhou
